title: dalea seemannii subsp. trochilina
intro: Dalea seemannii subsp. trochilina, commonly known as "Pink or White Butterfly Pea", is a plant species in the Fabaceae family, characterized by its vibrant pink or white flowers. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Dalea seemannii subsp. trochilina include its use in traditional medicine for wound healing, fever reduction, and as a natural dye. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
